g.text: One Line Item: evidence in, a Charge and a Limit out
A price band still exists, because
the Charge is a free option.
Channel C — one whole-Case model call
both a model band and a memory band?
fill or repair an incoherent band
Income is a whenever a <= t and it is
a wrongful rejection still owes it.
Above t it collapses by ~80%, so the
Charge always sits under the median —
further under the wider the band.
The Charge ignores coverage: on an
uncovered item t = 0, so a rejected
the bottom third of the posterior
IS the spike at zero — no special case
b = median x exp(sigma x z(q))
b = min(b, a) — the Limit is a lower quantile
of the same posterior than the Charge
round both to 2 decimals, floor at 0
layer this ItemPrice over the standard layer
BY INDEX — unknown indices are dropped
